---
name: bmad-advanced-elicitation
description: Explore consequential ambiguities or alternatives in a RAG feature request before committing to a solution. Use when the user asks for deeper discovery or tradeoff exploration.
---

# Advanced elicitation

Identify only the unknowns that could change the product behavior, data model,
security posture, cost, or deployment. Offer a small set of concrete options
with consequences, including keeping the current behavior. Ask focused
questions; do not turn a clear request into an unnecessary interview.

Ground questions in the current Spring Boot API, PostgreSQL/pgvector, RustFS,
provider configuration, and Docker Compose deployment.
